text:
Pranav: proposing a minimal change to our span/attr surface for inference traces. idea: keep span.name low-card (e.g. "inference.request") and push all variable bits into attributes. Avoid embedding model/route in name to stop metric explosion. thoughts?
Elaine: +1 on low-card names. we still need an easy way to quickly find traces for a specific model/version from the UI. attributes ok, but we should standardize keys and short enums for variants.
Jay: agree. concrete suggestion for attributes: `ri.route` (short id like `rt-text-gen`), `ri.model` (stable model id but NOT the full URL), `ri.variant` (quant/float16/etc), `ri.kv_cache` (`hit`/`miss`), `ri.input_tokens`, `ri.output_tokens`. Keep keys prefixed (`ri.`) to avoid collisions.
Anya: two concerns: 1) cardinality from freeform model strings, 2) retention / PII risk if we ever include prompt snippets. For (1) we should canonicalize model to a short code (e.g. `rwd-7b-q4`, `gptx-13b-v1`) and have a lookup table. For (2) never export raw prompt text to long-term exporters; keep short hashes or prompt tags instead.
Pranav: good call. also thinking about span phases: do we want more granular names like `inference.request.decode` vs a single `inference.request` attribute `ri.phase`? keeping name the same and add `ri.phase` might be cleaner. that way dashboards and apm views stay consistent.
Jay: +1 for `ri.phase`. For sampling rules: always sample on error, sample 1% of successful requests by default, and sample more for high-cost routes (e.g. >2000 tokens) — maybe 10%. we can implement that in the collector using token attributes.
Elaine: about exporters and retention: plan: raw spans with prompt hashes and full attrs -> local short-term store (7 days). Aggregated metrics (tokens, qps, errors) -> long-term metrics (90d+). Full traces (for debugging) -> export to traces-backend with 30d retention, but scrub PII before export. need a policy doc for scrub rules.
Anya: scrub rules: remove any attribute named `prompt_text`, `user_message`, or long `conversation` fields. If we must keep a snippet, use `prompt_hash` and `prompt_tag` (developer-provided). Also add `ri.sensitive=true` attr when request flagged via policy, which should route trace to higher-security retention (e.g., 3d only).
Pranav: decision items: (A) span.name => `inference.request` (single constant) (B) add `ri.phase` optional (e.g. `auth`, `route`, `queue`, `invoke`, `decode`) (C) attributes: `ri.route`, `ri.model_code`, `ri.variant`, `ri.kv_cache` (`hit`/`miss`), `ri.input_tokens`, `ri.output_tokens`, `ri.total_tokens`, `ri.sensitive` (bool), `ri.prompt_hash`, `ri.request_id` (opaque) (D) sampling: errors always, default 1% success, 10% for total_tokens>2000, override for dedicated customers.
Jay: small nit: use snake_case or dot? you used dots above — I prefer snake_case for attributes because some OTEL backends map dots to nested keys. e.g. `ri_model_code` vs `ri.model_code`.
Elaine: +1 to avoid dots in attribute names. let's use `ri_model`, `ri_model_variant`, `ri_kv_cache`. keep prefix `ri_` followed by short name.
Pranav: ok switch to snake underscore prefix. final attr list in code block for the telemetry team to implement:
```
span.name = "inference.request"
attributes:
  ri_route: "rt-text-gen"        # short route id
  ri_model_code: "rwd-7b-q4"     # canonicalized model id
  ri_model_variant: "q4_k"       # quant/float variant
  ri_kv_cache: "hit"|"miss"
  ri_input_tokens: "int"
  ri_output_tokens: "int"
  ri_total_tokens: "int"
  ri_phase: "auth|route|queue|invoke|decode"  # optional
  ri_sensitive: "true|false"
  ri_prompt_hash: "sha1hex"      # no raw text
  ri_request_id: "opaque-uuid"
```
Anya: love it. also please add `ri_export_level` so the collector can decide retention/export pipeline: `full`, `aggregated`, `none`. default `aggregated` for normal, `full` for internal debug routes.
Pranav: good idea. I'll add `ri_export_level`. also we need a small sample of example span -> UI query for dashboard owners so they can find high-cost routes: `span.name:inference.request AND ri_route:rt-batched-gptx AND ri_total_tokens:>2000`
SRE-Bot: deploy-check: linting rules updated to 1) deny dot in attribute keys, 2) require `ri_request_id` on all inference spans, 3) scrubbed prompt text required before export. CI job: `telemetry/attr-lint` will run on infra PRs.
Elaine: next steps: Pranav please open a short RFC with the attr list, sampling rules, and retention table. I'll coordinate with telemetry infra to schedule a rolling rollout. keep the UI folks in the loop for the queries and dashboards.
Pranav: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
